recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Richard Williams
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I've recently moved to the practice from another nearby in Altrincham. So far so good, much better responsiveness and the doctors have followed up an ailment to ensure continuity. Very impressed with the efficiency of this practice compared to my old one.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Keith Hadfield
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Very pleased with my appointment today with Dr Wright. He was very helpful, and informative.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Susan Collard
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Positive recent experience of available appointments for myself and my children at a busy time of year with empathy and good advice and support given.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Ash Simpson-Davies
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: As a young professional new to the area, I was looking to register with a new GP and used an upcoming holiday as a good reason to check my travel vaccination history. Liz and the reception team were fantastic they transferred everything over from my previous GP and carefully went through my vaccination records with me. It turned out I didn’t need any additional vaccines after all, but it was great to meet the team who’ll be looking after me and my future health. Thanks again, Ash

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Mickey Puri
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I had been told by a friend that St Johns was one of the very few surgeries that was doing something to find out if Statins would suit you. So I called them re this. A doctor called back same day but he said he was a Locum and was not aware of any test as this. Then at 7pm same day, Vanessa, the Practice Manager called me and said there had been a trial running that looked into this, and the trial was ending the next day. So she agreed to put me down for it and next day I took part in the trial. So its great that St Johns is taking part in such initiatives, and I was hugely grateful to Vanessa for calling me well outside normal surgery times and booking me onto the trial, that too in a Christmas Week. Very impressive and Well Done!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Charlotte Healey
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I am a big fan of the new booking system, having spent many an hour waiting for the appointment phone line to respond over the years. The doctors and nurse practitioners at this practice are first rate and now it’s even easier to book and amend appointments. The coordination of blood tests, prescriptions and results consultations is seamless. A great step forward! Huge thanks

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Tracey Leigh
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I visited St John’s recently with an issue with my ear . I got an appointment really easily . Dr Sangha was very attentive and helpful and I was referred very quickly . He is always very caring and a good listener

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: philgez
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Excellent doctor (Bethany) - clear and considerate and concise. Gave me the time I’m needed and was super helpful. A credit to the practice

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Graham Sadler
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Fantastic service. Saw doctor who was sympathetic and listened, with a few days, blood test and scans all done within a week.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Simon G
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Some good and bad experiences here. Was seen last year by a female doctor here who diagnosed me with anxiety and depression. I was referred for CBT treatment. The therapist, after many hours of talking therapy suggested that I may be suffering from a neurodiversity condition. I mentioned this to my GP on my next check in and was practically laughed at. The response was basically that we all experience these symptoms. I was embarrassed and didn’t raise the issue again. I was placed on a high dose of anti depressants and sent on my way. I’ve now stopped the medication abruptly as I am still experiencing the same problems - withdrawal is hell but I have no desire to return to this GP to revisit what was discussed with my therapist and have nowhere else to turn. Looking to transfer to a new GP to get the help I need

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Chuanjie Zhou
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I have great concerns about this medical centre, and I have no issue with doctors, but their reception team was very rude. You will never expect them to give you a smile. We have made an urgent appointment 9 am today for our granddaughter, who has had a bad cough with a running nose. We arrived at the medical centre 9:10am and at that time only one receptionist attended, but was continuously using the phone. We were waiting patiently for over five minutes until she finished her phone call. Then she told us that the appointment was invalid because we missed the appointment by over 15minutes. We tried to argue with her that we arrived at 9:10 am and the appointment should be valid. Suddenly, five receptionists appeared at the reception desk, showing a very aggressive manner, and one of the receptionists even threatened to call the police. I have to say, this reception team is arrogant, rude, and has a total lack of empathy for the patients. The management team should look into restructuring the reception team! I have checked all 53 Google reviews of this medical centre, and 26 out of 53 were one star, with an average score of 2.6. So far, this 2.6 score is the lowest within Greater Manchester that I have ever seen. 16 of 53 were complaints about their receptionists, which should tell you something!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Patrick Tarbuck
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: In a time when people find it easier to criticise our GP service and the health system, I think it’s really important to recognise truly excellent care. This is the best GP I’ve been at, they are patient, calm, accommodating and easy to deal with, which is even more remarkable when you consider how much vitriol and abuse they face on a daily basis. Well done to all the team at Altrincham medical practice, I feel very lucky to have this as my local practice.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Abhay
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I had an exceptional experience at Altrincham Medical Practice! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and highly professional. The doctors and nurses were incredibly thorough, taking the time to listen to my concerns and explain everything clearly. The level of care and attention to detail truly set this practice apart. The facilities were clean and well-organized, which added to the overall positive atmosphere. I left feeling reassured and confident in the care I received. If you're looking for a medical practice that combines professionalism with a personal touch, Altrincham Medical Practice is the one to choose. Highly recommended!"

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Marie Reid
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I find the negative reviews on getting an appointment astonishing. Call at 8am on the day and always get an appointment. I have been with this practice for over 30 years and they have seen me and my family through good and bad times.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: holly merrick
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: On Sunday I realised we were running extremely low on my daughter’s repeat medication. I ordered online that night and by Monday morning had a text it had been prescribed and another saying it was ready to collect from the pharmacy. Thank you for being so efficient. In a world where we only hear complaints about general practice I wanted to feedback some excellent work by the GP and admin staff.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Myra Neale
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I always find all staff and GPs are very helpful, I appreciate that very much

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Aramis ST
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: “Rude receptionists who hung up when I asked why they weren’t doing their job properly. Very unprofessional.”

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Moss Bank Clinic
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: "The doctors and receptionists provide fantastic service. They are very friendly and helpful. The referrals are fast and very helpful."

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: jingjing
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: My whole family have been with this practice for over 10 years. I am very happy with the service they provided. The doctors are very professional and patient with my 2 special needs kids. The nurses are friendly and willing to listen and help. The booking system did change after pandemic, but if you phone on time you will normally get an appointment. There will be a waiting time for the phone call to be answered but you will be told your waiting position. Thanks for everyone who works extremely hard. All of your help and effort are much appreciated.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: lynda holland
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Excellent practice with doctors who care

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Julie Martiradonna
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Been a patient here for nearly 40 years. My recent experience attending the surgery wasnt good. The receptionist was very abrupt and non-welcoming. After seeing the doctor, I then tried to book a routine appointment for 4 weeks and again the abrupt receptionist told me to phone the surgery in a week's time (because she couldn't be bothered) but I told her I wanted an appointment booking which she reluctantly did. Who is in charge of training these receptionists.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Jenny
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: All the receptionists attitude is bad especially Clair who shouted at the customers and falsely accused customers shouted at her to cover up the mistake that she has made. Waiting few weeks for a single prescription is extremely frustrating.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: ghada mansour
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Very professional and always accessible

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Kirsten Campbell
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Dr Phillip Stratford-Smith is a credit to this GP surgery. He has made time and devoted so much energy into assisting me through the complexities of PTSD over the last 6-8 months and I feel that he deserves the recognition for his capacity to care and serve his patients with dignity and respect, trust and compassion. Thank you Sir, for all you have done in releasing me from my traumatised state by listening without prejudice and open heartedness. You are amazing.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Aimei Chen
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: It is absolutely difficult to get an appointment from surgery. I always ring at 8am on time, but there is long queue more than 20 person ahead me. I have to wait to call me back. No surprise, they will say we are fully book when they call back.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Can never book an appointment, always refer to 111 or A&E

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Dennis Phillips
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Excellent service by all the Doctors and staff, amazing. So caring and thorough.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Samreen Abid

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Registered for more than 5 yrs now. Very supportive staff at reception. Whenever needed appointment, did not had any trouble. Dr Lavanya Subbiah is simply a star GP. She has a keen listening ear for patients and always meets the patient expectations rather exceeds them.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Glen
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Always amazing the whole team thank you

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Mohamad Aly

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: No travel vaccine available at GP, no information on where can we get through NHS. In the end did in a private service paying expensive fee.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Natalie Sellars
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Fantastic doctors. Always lovely receptionists and can make appointments very quickly.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: OHSHOOT UK
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: This place is always clean and great GP service and extra services. Serves local community very well

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: helene Manchester
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I have been at the Village Surgery since around 2007 and after reading the reviews on Google, I thought I had to try to rectify the records as I believe they should get a full 5 stars. The doctors are second to none. They are part of this new generation of professionals who are open to their patients' opinion, take time to listen to their concerns and expectations and go to the extent of reseaching on topics if needs be. I have always felt that they actually enjoyed their profession. My friends based in other surgeries can't believe the help I get from my doctors. The office manager is very capable; some of the receptionists can be a bit unpolished but generally, the service at the desk is very good. The building is clean and welcoming. Parking is not always easy but arriving a good 10 minutes before the appointment can help as people come but also vacate quite quickly.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Gina maria Martin
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Kindness and professional support

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Mister E
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Went to the health center to check child’s weight and height. The lady at the reception didn’t really care, just told me to take a number card from the desk and wait. 5 minutes later, another lady came and got a number below mine and the nurse came out and called her in before us. When we went inside, she didn’t even care and just said everything looks fine and didn’t really answer my concerns. Just told me to see the GP if I have any concerns. So I don’t know why I bothered to come check my child’s weight and height when I already did that at home. I came for some diet advice but none was given. The only positive experience was that there were plenty of parking.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Frank Tomlin
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: First class treatment from a well managed health centre, the Doctor who treated me for cortazone injection was A one

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Hannon Maher
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Nice building with friendly staff. The older male Dr Westwood was, to be frank, quite apathetic. Maybe this has resulted in many years in the field with retirement on the horizon, or maybe it was because I was a young man who he didn't take seriously. Answered questions vaguely and acted with a slightly condescending tone. He isn't someone I'd recommend you go talk to for anything important. He even forgot to book me something for me which he said he would (for this it was his job to not mine). Aside from this everything is perfect. Reception staff are great keep it up!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Alexandra Cherouvim
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: What a let down to come in an emergency on a Sunday just to find it closed. Google said it was open.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Julie Chadwick
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Very good

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Adam O'Neill
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Been with this GP for ~14 years, absolutely no issues. Great receptionists, great doctors.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Danielle Williamson
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Can't fault this place 😊 lovely reception & medical staff and efficient services for both myself and my child. Refreshing, thank you all ☺️ …

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Kerry Louise
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I had to do a review as this surgery is exceptional, All staff in this practice are amazing, the receptionists are so friendly and kind they just put you at ease instantly on the phone. The Dr's are very professional yet friendly and caring. I honestly can't fault this surgery at all. I'm so pleased it's our family doctors. Thankyou all of you, Kerry.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Norah O'Shea
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: The Village Surgery is a great practice! The Doctors, nurses, physio Dept & especially the reception team….. The receptionists are all so helpful & friendly when you call the practice:) 5 stars all the way:)

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Nigel
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Staff and doctors are always superb

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Anthony Chadwick
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Friendly staff. Is smoothly functioning surgery. Like it.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Diane Mansell
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: We had to switch Mum last year to this practice when her previous one closed suddenly. We have had superb care from her Drs who have taken time to ring with an update after home visits and Reception staff are very understanding , kind and helpful of her condition. We have been well supported throughout by the GPs and the Macmillan team who liaise regularly together to give the best care possible.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Hilary Walsh
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Always manage to get an appointment, really friendly reception staff and Doctors, I've never felt so well looked after before now, thank you

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Bobbie-Jo Stockton
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I’m genuinely grateful to be registered with this GP practice. Every interaction I’ve had has been kind, respectful, and reassuring. The doctors and nurses take the time to really listen, explain things clearly, and treat you like a person rather than a number. The reception team are always helpful and patient, even under pressure. When you’re unwell or worried, having a practice like this makes a huge difference. Thank you to everyone for the care, compassion, and dedication you show every day.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Rania Naqvi
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Worst ever and not empathetic Service. After cancelling several bookings finally and Unfortunately they gave us appointment with Dr Sobia Khan and it was the horrible experience.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Kong Ng
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: We have always been with this GP under our postcode area (WA14/15), but they changed their catchment area quietly without any notice. Suddenly, we were no longer within their coverage. When my wife needed to see a doctor, the NHS app still allowed her to book an appointment. However, when she arrived, instead of being asked about her symptoms, the first question was, “Why are you here at this GP?” As an organisation responsible for safeguarding the health of local residents, it is disappointing that they chose to turn away an unwell patient rather than provide care and then explain that her address is no longer within their service area.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: olivia wilson
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Such a good gp, receptionists are all lovely, never a long wait time on the phone. Dr Hurst is amazing too, my appointment didn’t feel rushed at all and really took her time to explain everything to me😊 …

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Jenny
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Monday, 27th October I spoke to Sara at 08:12 I said I would like to book an appointment for my husband Roger. He had difficulty breathing and his peakflow was very low, and a back cough.She said I can't book a telephone appointment. She said I had to book online which I did. I requested a telephone call after 12pm. I also requested that they phone Roger on his home landlines as he doesn't have a smart phone. I received a reminder message showing up on phone at 17:00 saying can Roger come in today to the surgery at 15:20 Luckily my husband phoned the surgery at 11:15 to remind them to use the landlines and luckily he found out the appointment was in person and he was able to go in good time. The fact that I had no knowledge of the appointment to 17:00 meant my husband would have missed his appointment had he not phoned the surgery at 11:15

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Robert Blanchard
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I’d like to thank the receptionist that was on the desk this morning that asked Doctor Mathews to see me who then advised me to go to A&E to be checked over, they very kindly rang for an ambulance to take me to A&E and I got the all clear. So once again many thanks to the receptionist and also to Doctor Mathews.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Iain Whiteley

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Whenever I ring Dr Patels practice the phone is answered quickly and politely. The medical and admin responses have always been efficient and courteous.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Generally, you have good days and bad days with doctor surgeries, but I feel quite anxious whenever I visit my gps surgery ,some of on the phone not very compassionate, often condescending, some of the doctors are very good once you get an appointment but some of them always rush you if you’re in the queue and this people in front of you and you’ve ended up coming to your appointment on time but been delayed because someone or another is chatting to The receptionist about their selves , then the doctor told you that You’re late and don’t listen to other issues . I actually feel very anxious when calling over visiting the surgery and try to avoid it even if I’m in desperate need

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Anne Earley
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I am surprised to find such negative reviews of this practice. We have been patients at Shay Lane for decades and have received excellent treatment from Dr Patel, Dr Taylor Bernard, Dr Leaver, Sister Norris and all the other doctors and nursing staff past and present. Not only are the medical staff of the highest calibre but the appointments system is amazing. We are always able to speak to or see a doctor face to face on the same day. When compared with the experience of friends who have to go through Ask my GP and are then unable to get an appointment anyway this is nothing short of remarkable!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I was considering moving to this practice, however I was given incorrect information by the receptionist. When I emailed the Practice Manager she defended the receptionist, despite having an incorrect version of events. Not only that but her reply was rude, cold, and lacked empathy. If the front of house staff are any reflection of the GP’s then avoid at all costs. Glad to be staying with my current friendly and caring practice.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: The doctors have always been wonderful here, however the receptions are rude and unhelpful.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Dear Scopes, Thank you for your review. Kind regards, Padgate Medical Centre

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: WAYNE LARGE
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Possibly one of the most disappointing experiences I’ve ever had with senior doctors. After being told by district nurses and undertakers that I could collect a death certificate to register my parent’s passing, I arrived at the practice only to be informed that the procedure had changed. Neither the nurses nor the detailed NHS leaflet I was given reflected this change, leading to unnecessary confusion at an already difficult time. When I asked to speak to the manager, I was instead met by her secretary, who I initially assumed was the manager until informed otherwise. Despite requesting the manager again and asking for the new procedure in writing, I was then redirected to a junior doctor. They asked me to fill out a form I had already completed with the district nurse, which then had to be emailed. To make matters worse, I later received a call from a senior doctor accusing me of upsetting and being rude to staff—a claim that was both unfounded and deeply upsetting. This same doctor, during a previous home visit, did not even know my parent’s name. On the phone, her tone was condescending and defensive when I questioned her. Over recent months, during an incredibly emotional period, I have consistently found this practice to be unhelpful, lacking in empathy, and frequently contradictory in their communication. Sensitive matters were often discussed in the crowded reception area, which felt completely inappropriate and disrespectful. This experience added unnecessary stress during bereavement, and I sincerely hope the practice takes steps to improve their procedures and communication in the future.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I’d be apprehensive to say this practice even deserves one star. I had been registered here for the past approximately 15 years and throughout attended this practice for multiple ongoing problems which I feel have been ignored and unseen to despite countless visits. The main problem is not the qualified healthcare staff but the overall system and management, I work in healthcare myself and understand that sometimes no matter how well patients are treated by staff they are still failed by the declining system of the NHS. Although I have felt ignored by some practitioners whose names I cannot remember, nurse Karen and mental health practitioner Ian have been great and have always listened to my health issues thoroughly. The reception staff answer calls with rude manner (I can’t say all as I have had kind receptionists previously but the majority of time not) and they appear uninterested in answering your queries and concerns. The appointment availability is unacceptable, attempting to arrange an on the day appointment at 8am often leaves you without one and trying to pre book an appointment leaves you with a 3-7 week wait and there is no acknowledgement of urgent symptoms. Sometimes they’ll tell you a GP will contact you over the phone on the day to assess your symptoms and then no one rings you all day from the practice. The final straw for me was when I rang last week describing tachycardia, feeling faint and CHEST PAIN and they told me they had no appointments for 4 weeks, neither did they advise me on what to do or where else to go for urgent medical attention. I have since changed practice and they have been a huge improvement.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Some of the doctors here are more thoughtful than others but overall they reflect institutional neglect. I'm dealing with a disabling and frightening chronic condition that has been poorly investigated and diagnosed by the NHS and this health center. Tests have always comeback within their very broad definition of 'normal' and they refuse to apply any further clinical consideration to a patients' actual clinical picture. I asked for my medical records and I still haven't received the requested information three months later. I've complained but received no response. One receptionist a month ago completely ignored me. Then she dealt with me as if it was an inconvenience. The online triage system is now a grim joke. It frequently suspends the option to make an appointment for a week or more, and then every alternative method of contact filters you back to it. The clinic is at the forefront of a modern dysfunctional NHS where compassion disappeared decades ago. The patient comes very last in its considerations and it merely a source of LHA funding. Addendum : I am now discovering that the causes that I suggested for my illness and was laughed out of the surgery with ('Dr' Yazicci actually laughed at them) are indeed the issue and I am now self medicating with considerbale success. The dimissal of my theories by this surgery has cost me years of my life as I didn't act on it. Any attempt to complain to them is water off a duck's back to them. I've since changed surgeries. When I mentioned I was going to this, this one became even less responsive and more dismissive.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Dawn Edge
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I used to boast about my GP practice but no longer. Service has declined dramatically in the last 12-18 months. Clinical staff are great when you can see them - 3 week wait for appointment and virtually impossible to get through on telephone. Didn't think it was possible, but service getting worse! No response to 2 triage forms. Cannot get through on phone. Little wonder A&E overwhlemed!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Filled in triage form and was then phoned to make an appointment. Doctor was lovely and asked me to arrange to go for blood tests. recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: First Last
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Just had to make a complaint for the first time EVER! I've been waiting MONTHS to get an appointment for plantar fasciitis, and finally had an appointment today, Thurs Sept 18th at 1.30pm. I thought it was at the Bramhall Health Centre close to the centre of Bramhall, and I got there for 1.30pm. Turns out it wasn't, so I have to double back to the very similarly-named Bramhall Park Medical Centre (your texts don't specify the address!) - which is twinned with Shaw Heath, get there for bang on 1.40pm, but I'm only on time to be classed as 'late' and marked down as Did Not Attend. I've rebooked for a couple of weeks from now, but after all this time of waiting, I think this is a DISGUSTING, INTRANSIGENT SYSTEM! Even Michael Douglas in Falling Down only went over 3 minutes at Whammy Burger, but for this, I was late at the precise moment my appointment was cancelled. I did ask if I could still be seen, but Computer Says No. As a result, to say I am ANGRY is an UNDERSTATEMENT! I'll be surprised if anyone cares about this complaint.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: As of October 1st 2025 gov.uk made the announcement that patients in the UK, will be able to request appointments online throughout the day, rather than calling their surgery or visiting in person. We are now almost 2 weeks into that announcement, and Whitworth surgery has yet to reinstate their online booking system which has been unoperational since November 2022! Speaking as a person who works full time and begins at 7:30am, making an appointment outside of works time is pretty much impossible and, if you are fortunate enough to get an appointment, it's often a month away and in working hours. Online booking is essential for those who are employed, and in order to access this it has to be operational. Surely nearly 3 years to get it back up and running is plenty of time?

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Reluctant 3, 2.5 might’ve been better but wasn’t an option a 2 felt a bit harsh. Staff I’ve dealt with in the while have been professional and friendly (there was one GP who referred to me as a ‘good girl’ and ‘good little girl’ multiple times on a telephone appointment (I’m definitely no a little girl at the age of 32!) this was when I had been discussing my recent mental health improvement following a dose adjustment from a different GP. It’s a nightmare getting an appointment, I set my alarm for 0758, have a minute to warm up my fingers and then call and call and call. Once I was 2nd in the queue for 40minutes when I called immediately after opening, God only knows what was happening there that morning but there was no apology. I often manage to see the same GP (done through the app, booking 3-4 weeks in advance and checking any newly released appointments a couple of times a day) he is always late, but always apologetic and I don’t mind as I think this means he’s giving people a little more time when needed, we don’t always fit into a 10-15minute slot! Whenever I’ve been for bloods or to see the nurse they’ve been pretty close to on time and polite. I feel as though they have too many patients for the number of staff at the surgery, if people could just get an appointment it would go a long way to a good experience/review. Had a telephone appointment today, surgery closed over an hour ago and I’ve had no call. I’m assuming it’s not happening now 😂 after spending all day with my phone glued to me in case I missed a call!

recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Have been a patient here for years. Such a shame that it is now so difficult to get an appointment. There is no continuity with regards to doctors and if you're lucky to get an appointment, you are essentially a stranger each time you go. You can't get through at 8am when the phone lines open. You are told that you can attend at 8am to make an appointment in person, but even then, due to the limited number of appointments available (lack of actual doctors) i have had times where I have attended at 8am and by the time I am seen, all appointments have gone. It seems a totally ridiculous way to run a doctor's surgery. The nurse practitioner is abrupt and rude and acts like the cost of a prescription comes out of her own pocket. When told that there were a couple of things that needed to be mentioned to her ( due to having had to wait a good few weeks to get an appointment) she responded by saying that she only had time to discuss one thing!!! Roisin the practice nurse is lovely and the most helpful member of staff at the surgery, and also seems to be the most overworked staff there too. The reception staff are generally as helpful as they can be but without actual doctors to see patients, the surgery would seem to be struggling.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Vikrant Kalukhe
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I visited the practice for an in-person appointment to obtain a fit note while suffering from flu symptoms, including a high fever. I had made significant effort to attend despite feeling very unwell. Upon arrival, I was informed by the receptionist that the appointment was actually a telephone consultation, which was not indicated when the booking was made or confirmed. I politely pointed this out, explaining that it appeared to be an administrative error, and suggested it might help to flag this to prevent similar mix-ups for other patients in the future (e.g., someone travelling unnecessarily while ill). Unfortunately, instead of acknowledging the mistake or apologising, the receptionist repeated that I did not need to wait in the surgery for the call – raising her voice and speaking slowly and loudly on the second occasion. This felt highly patronising and dismissive, especially when I was already feeling extremely unwell and vulnerable. In the end, the journey was wasted, and I left without the consultation proceeding as expected. Clearer communication about appointment types and better handling of patient feedback when errors occur would greatly improve the experience here.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Vicki venables
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: My review for the doctors We have been with this doctors surgery now for a few years. As my grandad became more poorly he had a doctor out most weeks as the doctor who came out was Dr Charlotte Kennedy I can't thank you enough you had patience and you took your time you didn't rush. But you didn't just support my grandad you also supported us as a family. There are many GP's that have looked after my grandad over the years and have gave great care. He also had nurses coming out for bloods mostly Naomi thank you for being so patient with him when you came to do his bloods. recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Amanda Neville
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: A masterclass in how not to run a GP surgery. Reception staff appear to have taken on the role of clinicians, routinely dismissing concerns, deciding what does and does not warrant medical attention, and frequently redirecting patients to A&E or out-of-hours services for minor or ongoing issues. One wonders when this became part of their job description. GP consultations offer little improvement. Complex medical conditions, mental health concerns, and written recommendations from specialists are met with indifference or ignored altogether. Listening appears optional; empathy entirely absent. Complaints are treated with the same enthusiasm as patient care — acknowledged, if at all, then quietly disregarded. Patients are spoken to in a patronising manner and left feeling foolish for seeking help. If you are looking for accessible, patient-centred care, this is not the place. If, however, you enjoy being dismissed, redirected elsewhere, and made to feel like an inconvenience, this surgery may be exactly what you’re looking for.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: John Neill
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: Do not register at this practice. The worst treatment myself and my partner have ever received. The GP’s are utterly unequipped to deal with anything other than a cold. The receptionists are the rudest, most inept people I’ve ever had the displeasure to come across and should have their parole revoked (I’m assuming they’re on parole given the aggressive behaviour they show anytime you ring up). As for the administrative staff, they seem to be incapable of reading a clinical letter, ignorant of how their ineptitude affects patient care, or blatantly money-grubbers. The practices operate a “total-triage” system that is a choice given to them by the government to abandon patient care in favour of increased subsidies. I probably don’t need to explain at this point; they took the subsidies! They don’t care about patients, and If they ever did they were incapable of doing anything about it.

recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Deborah Walton
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I have had a horrendous experience being registered with this group practice. I made a complaint about a senior admin worker who denied receiving 3 letters from my solicitor after waiting 12mths for a copy of my gp notes . Then my Gp notes were destroyed vindictivly I am amazed that the practice manager didn't know it was gross Misconduct and a criminal offence to tamper, alter or fix a patients notes. I know this by comments passed to me at a practice managers meeting. I had no option but to report this to the GMC who passed it to NHS England to investigate. My case was to serious for them to investigate as they should do because I named 2 Gp s who I had apts with and went in, sat down. The Gp looked at his screen and didn't speak when I told him my reason for going to see a Gp, he totally ignored me and after what felt like 30 mins of silence I got up and left his room. I had no idea Dr's behaved this way and happened twice with 2 Gp's. NHS England conducted a corrupt investigation without a single meeting with me. I found out 12mths later that the GMC worked with NHS England on this investigation, they don't work together. All this came to the senior Gp at the practice who was responsible for the surgery, I now know he took early retirement before the investigation got going. Ever since I have been treated very badly by every Gp I have seen at several practices. I am denied Healthcare, treatment and medication across the board even mental health services have been closed to me. I have been set up by mental health nurses who requested a urine sample under the order of a consultant. The drug test they did came up positive for every substance you can think of but my prescribed medication didn't show up on the drug test, codeine and pregabalin are both controlled drugs and medication I take every day. Think this proves it was all staged and a set up, you don't expect this from a mental health nurse. Had I taken any kind of class A drugs I wouldn't have given anyone a urine sample. I was left bent in half with horrific back pain the Gp practice I was registered with Mark Street Surgery refused to review my pain relief or increase it. I am now disabled for the rest of my life and under a spinal surgeon at Salford with a life curve of my spine. recent_reviews_across_manchester.author: Sandeep Tandon
recent_reviews_across_manchester.text: I ordered my repeat prescription via the app several days ago. When I attended the pharmacy, I was told the prescription had not been authorised by the doctor. On Thursday, I attended the surgery and was informed by the receptionist that the particular doctor was “not in”. I explained the urgency and asked for the prescription to be pushed through. I was then assured that my medication would be ready to collect from the pharmacy on Saturday morning. Today (Saturday 17/01/26), I attended the pharmacy at 1pm, only to find that it was closed. Both the pharmacy and the GP surgery are now closed. As of today, I have completely run out of my prescribed medication, including Ramipril and Atorvastatin. I have disabilities and suffer from high blood pressure, and being without this medication places my health at risk. I am extremely concerned that the online prescription service is being promoted, yet it is ineffective if prescriptions are not authorised in a timely manner. The system only works if doctors take responsibility for approving patients’ medication. I would like this matter urgently reviewed, an explanation provided as to how this situation was allowed to occur, and assurances that this does not happen again. I also request immediate advice on how I can obtain my medication as soon as possible. I look forward to your prompt response. Yours faithfully, S
